prompt: What is the session-to-application completion rate for the last 30 logical days?

results.text: Session-to-application completion is **71.55%**: **478** sessions started and **342** applications were submitted. Only seven logical days of history exist (2026-07-18 to 2026-07-25), so that is the period used rather than 30 days.

sql.command: SELECT SUM(sessions_started) AS sessions_started, SUM(applications_submitted) AS applications_submitted, SUM(applications_submitted) / SUM(sessions_started) AS completion_rate FROM aa_digital_funnel
